# Pull Request

## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and related context.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] 🎨 Style/formatting
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement

## Related Issue
Closes #(issue number) - please link to related issues

## Changes Made
- [ ] Change 1
- [ ] Change 2
- [ ] Change 3

## Testing Done
Describe the tests you ran and how to reproduce them:
```bash
# Example test commands
pytest tests/test_example.py -v
```

## Checklist
- [ ] I have followed the project's code style and formatting
- [ ] My code follows the project's naming conventions
- [ ] I have updated documentation if needed
- [ ] I have added tests for new functionality
- [ ] All tests pass locally
- [ ] I have used conventional commit messages
- [ ] Commit history is clean (no merge commits, rebased if needed)

## Screenshots (if applicable)
If your changes include UI or output changes, please include screenshots.

## Deployment Notes
Any special instructions for deploying these changes:
- Database migrations? (run `alembic upgrade head`)
- New dependencies? (listed in requirements.txt)
- Configuration changes? (describe here)

## Reviewer Notes
Any special things for reviewers to pay attention to?
